shortDescription: UPSSSC Pharmacist Ayurvedic 2024 Syllabus – professional and general subjects.
content:
UPSSSC Pharmacist (Ayurvedic) syllabus focuses on Ayurvedic pharmacy subjects along with general awareness components if prescribed.

Core areas

  • Dravyaguna / Rasashastra basics as per diploma syllabus
  • Ayurvedic pharmacy practice
  • Pharmacology / dosage forms related topics
  • General Hindi / GK (as per official scheme)

Refer the official Pharmacist Ayurvedic advertisement for unit-wise details.
